name: popsicle
headline: Atlabs - AI Video Creation Platform
short_description: Atlabs is an innovative video creation platform that uses AI to help businesses produce captivating videos effortlessly. With no need for creative or technical skills, users can generate marketing content in minutes, making it ideal for social media and viral campaigns.
author: architrathi

sections.overview:
Atlabs is an end-to-end AI video marketing platform designed for businesses that need to produce professional videos quickly without creative or technical expertise. Users input text or import existing content, and the platform automatically generates videos with AI-written scripts, motion graphics, realistic voiceovers, styled captions, and background music. The AI Brand Model personalizes videos to match your business by analyzing your website, while the script writer draws from millions of viral video examples to eliminate writer's block. Atlabs supports 40+ languages with one-click localization, making it suitable for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and social media campaigns. The platform offers 20 free monthly credits, with advanced features available through optional upgrades.
Creating promotional videos for social media
Generating engaging TikTok content
Producing YouTube Shorts quickly
Crafting short stories for marketing campaigns
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install architrathi/Atlabs`
`git clone https://github.com/architrathi/Atlabs`
sections.usage:
```
Create a 30-second promotional video for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] using Atlabs. The video should highlight [KEY FEATURES] and target [TARGET AUDIENCE]. Use a dynamic and engaging tone with vibrant visuals and upbeat music.
```
Copy

